title: apps/provisioning is a types+domain-logic library, not a running service
answers: Where does provisioning's HTTP server or reconcile loop live?
What's the module boundary between apps/provisioning and pkg/registry/apis/provisioning?
body: apps/provisioning is a standalone Go module (own go.mod, module github.com/grafana/grafana/apps/provisioning, listed in go.work:26) implementing Grafana's Git Sync/provisioning domain: syncing dashboards/folders to external repos (GitHub, GitHub Enterprise, generic Git, local fs) and OAuth/GitHub-App 'Connections'. It has no main(), no HTTP server, no reconcile loop. It defines: API kinds (Repository, Job, HistoricJob, Connection) in pkg/apis/provisioning/v0alpha1/; the repository.Repository/Extra/Factory abstraction + backends in pkg/repository/{git,github,local}/; the mirrored connection.Connection/Extra/Factory abstraction in pkg/connection/{github,githuboauth,oauth}/; admission mutate/validate logic in pkg/jobs/ and *validator*.go files; stateless helpers (pkg/quotas, pkg/safepath, pkg/loki); status-patch helpers in pkg/controller/; generated clientset/informers/listers in pkg/generated/. The actual API server, HTTP routes, and job-execution workers live outside this directory in pkg/registry/apis/provisioning/ (main module), which imports apps/provisioning as a dependency.
